verdict.rationale: Adyen's Protect risk system offers a rule builder for creating, backtesting, and labeling custom rules. Every payment is evaluated against these rules, and the result automatically blocks, allows, or sends the transaction to review. Webhooks push event notifications to your server, but any action beyond risk decisions must be built in your own code. missing for 10: a general-purpose rule/workflow engine beyond fraud risk, configurable actions beyond block/allow/review, in-depth docs on rule conditions and triggers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
